title: Weekly threat-intel brief, schema v1
description: One week of the brief, saved as reports/YYYY-MM-DD_YYYY-MM-DD/data.json. A file this schema accepts passes `pnpm check:week` with no errors, except for rules a schema cannot express: unique theme keys and source ids, key_items that exist in sources, real calendar days, the window order and the folder name. Layout warnings live in lib/check.mjs. Unknown fields are allowed and ignored, so a field can be captured before the site shows it. A node with "$comment": "soft" is checked as a warning only, because the site ignores a bad value there: fields kept for the record, the optional funnel counts and the proposed fields in data-ingestion/PROPOSED.md.

themes.description: Themes that met the bar, in any order. The page sorts them by rank. Keys must be unique. 3 to 12 read best.

ranking.description: Accounts per storyline, most first. Every theme, plus storylines that missed the bar.

sources.description: Every post or video behind the themes. Ids must be unique.

title.description: Week page heading. Up to 60 characters.

start.description: First IST minute of the week. A real calendar day that matches the folder.

end.description: Last IST minute of the week. A real calendar day that matches the folder, not before start.

generated.description: When the file was written, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM IST". The index shows it as the published date.

bottom_line.description: One or two sentences for the week lead and the index. Up to 240 characters. Without it the lead is built from the top theme.

capture.description: When each platform was read, "<start> to <end>". Notes show one row per string entry, so a new platform can add its own key.

x_posts.description: X rows in sources. A whole number from 0. The checker warns when they differ.

youtube_videos.description: YouTube rows in sources. A whole number from 0. The checker warns when they differ.

comments_analysed_top_themes.description: Comments analysed on the themes. The comments KPI and the last comment funnel stage.

candidates.description: Sources funnel, stage 1: posts and videos on topic before themes were picked.

candidates_x.description: Kept for the record. X share of candidates.

candidates_youtube.description: Kept for the record. YouTube share of candidates.

sources_in_top_themes.description: Kept for the record. The page counts sources instead.

comments_retrieved.description: Comments funnel, stage 1: every comment fetched.

comments_analysed_all.description: Comments funnel, stage 3: comments left after exclusions, on every candidate.

themes_kept.description: Kept for the record. The page counts themes instead.

comment_exclusions.description: Why comments were dropped. Shown under the comments funnel.

in_window.description: Comments funnel, stage 2: retrieved comments posted inside the window.

counts.description: The three required counts, plus optional funnel counts. The funnel shows in notes as "What was kept" when two stages of a funnel are numbers.

methodology.description: Shown in notes when method_steps is missing.

method_steps.description: The method as 3 to 7 steps. Replaces the methodology paragraph.

inaccessible.description: Sources that could not be read in full. Hidden when empty.

also_observed.description: Stories in the window that did not make a theme. One or two sentences each.

accounts.description: Kept for the record. Monitored accounts by group.

rank.description: 1 is the most covered. Number the themes 1 to n, once each. The page numbers them by position, so a gap or a repeat still renders 1 to n. The checker warns.

key.description: Id of the storyline, used in #theme-<key> links. Reuse it in later weeks so the week-over-week arrows work.

short_name.description: Label for the side menu, charts and cards. Up to 12 characters, unique in the week. Without it the name is cut at 11 characters.

why.description: Why it matters, in the warning callout. Up to 600 characters.

why_line.description: One sentence for the top-3 cards and the index. Up to 140 characters. Without it the cards cut `why` at three lines.

actions.description: Up to 5 steps for defenders, one imperative sentence each. Shown as a tip callout.

distinct_accounts.description: Accounts that covered the theme. The ranking metric, a whole number from 0.

x_engagement.description: Interactions on the theme's X posts.

youtube_views.description: Views on the theme's YouTube videos.

key_items.description: Source ids, best first. Each must be in sources. Three show and the rest fold.

sentiment.description: Totals for the theme. Without it the clusters are added up. The checker warns when they differ.

cves.description: CVE ids in this theme, each once. Each should have a cve_details entry.

exploited_in_wild.description: true when any CVE here is exploited. null when not confirmed.

both_vendor_and_media.description: Kept for the record. True when vendors and media both covered the theme.

first_seen.description: Proposed. First day the storyline was reported anywhere.

tags.description: Proposed. Lowercase kebab-case topics, for example "ransomware" or "supply-chain". Up to 5.

threat_actors.description: Proposed. Actors or groups named by at least one vendor source.

attack_techniques.description: Proposed. MITRE ATT&CK techniques named by the sources.

references.description: Proposed. Primary sources beyond social posts: advisories, vendor research, government alerts. Up to 5.

id.description: CVE-YYYY-NNNN. Must also be listed in the theme's cves to show.

exploited_in_wild.description: true = exploited (red). false = not exploited. null = not confirmed.

basis.description: The evidence for the state, with the outlet in brackets.

advisory_url.description: Vendor or NVD advisory, http or https.

kev.description: Proposed. true when listed in the CISA KEV catalog.

kev_added.description: Proposed. Day it was added to KEV.

vendor.description: Proposed. Vendor of the affected product.

published.description: Proposed. Day the CVE was published.

label.description: What the comments say. Up to 90 characters.

sentiment_counts.description: Counts for positive, neutral, negative and unclassified. Leave out a mood with no comments.

parent_url.description: The post it replies to, http or https. Anything else shows without a link.

platform.description: Case-sensitive. A new platform shows with a spare colour.

type.description: Case-sensitive. A new type shows with a spare colour.

date_ist.description: "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM" in IST, inside the window. The by-day chart uses the date.

url.description: http or https. Anything else shows without a link.

engagement.description: Interactions on X, views on YouTube. A whole number from 0.

theme.description: A theme key, or a ranking key for a storyline below the bar.

metrics.description: Raw counts by name, for example {"views": 826905}. Shown in the engagement tooltip. Non-numbers are skipped.

image.description: Thumbnail URL, http or https, about 16:9.

followers.description: Proposed. Followers or subscribers of the account at capture.

key.description: A theme key, or a new key for a storyline below the bar.

short_name.description: Up to 12 characters. Falls back to the theme's.

accounts.description: Accounts that covered the storyline. Sort the list by it, most first.
